validity.researcher_notes: The Interfax item of February 2023 shows a real two-string branch from Kartaly to Magnitogorsk, with main-line pipe of 1020 and 720 mm. Caveat: the item does not say which string has which diameter, so the sheet diameter of both sizes for this row could cover both strings.

fills.researcher_notes: An Interfax Russia item of 21 February 2023 (read as a Wayback capture of March 2023) says the Kartaly to Magnitogorsk branch is built of main-line pipe of 1020 and 720 mm, and that four sections of 720 mm pipe were replaced. It covers both strings together.

verifications.note: В 1963 году было закончено строительство первой нитки ... а через три года ... вторая нитка

fills.researcher_notes: The same item says the first string of the Kartaly to Magnitogorsk branch was finished in 1963 and the second string was built three years later, so in 1966. This row is the first string, start 1963.

verifications.note: Ремонт в январе и феврале этого года выполнялся по очереди на первой и второй нитках

fills.researcher_notes: The same item, dated 21 February 2023, describes repair work in January and February 2023 on both strings of the Kartaly to Magnitogorsk branch and says pressure was raised to design values, so the line is in use. It does not use the word operating.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status operating fits. Repairs on both strings were done in January and February 2023 and gas pressure was brought to design values.

wiki_citations_read.note: The page returns an access-restricted notice, and no Wayback capture was found.
Interfax Russia item of 21 February 2023. Both strings, diameters 1020 and 720 mm, first string 1963, second string 1966, repair in early 2023.

summary: "Kartaly-Magnitogorsk first string: diameter, start and status backed by the Interfax Russia item of Feb 2023; confirmed (caveat)"
